reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: I pick a greens powder mostly on faith that it's actually doing something for my health, since I can't really prove the benefit even after months of drinking it, and then I just rebuy the same tub when it runs out.

scenarios.label: Loyal brand re-up
scenarios.description: Refilling the same greens they already use, quickly choosing the familiar tub from their go-to store.

scenarios.label: First-time start
scenarios.description: Deciding to add a daily greens to their routine after research and recommendations.

scenarios.label: In-store substitute pick
scenarios.description: Switching brands at the shelf when the usual option is out or pricier, comparing claims and reviews quickly.

scenarios.label: Taste-first search
scenarios.description: Choosing a greens they believe they can drink daily, often after tasting a sample or a friend's jar.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Loyal brand re-up|generic] My schedule went back to travel mode and my veggies went out the window. Energy is meh, digestion cranky. What can I add to my morning routine that helps cover the gaps without a ton of prep?

[problem_recognition|First-time start|generic] i eat pretty clean but i still miss a lot of greens and feel flat by mid afternoon. is there a simple daily habit that can help cover the nutrients i'm not getting?

[problem_recognition|In-store substitute pick|generic] At the store right now. Need a quick grab that helps with veggies and digestion when meals are all over the place. No fridge at work. What should I look for on the label to know it's actually worth it?
[problem_recognition|Taste-first search|generic] i need more greens in me but everything "healthy" i try tastes like lawn. any way to get that stuff in daily without gagging?
[discovery|Loyal brand re-up|generic] Best greens powder for a busy routine that mixes with just water and actually covers energy, gut, and immune support?
[discovery|First-time start|generic] What's the best daily greens powder for a first timer that doesn't taste too grassy and is fine on an empty stomach?
[discovery|In-store substitute pick|generic] in the grocery aisle now. what's the best greens powder i can grab off the shelf that mixes smooth in water and doesn't leave a weird aftertaste?
[discovery|Taste-first search|generic] best-tasting greens powder that still has real nutrition, not just flavoring. what should i get?
[shortlist|Loyal brand re-up|generic] I'm re-upping. Can you give me a short list of a few reliable daily greens powders that travel well and don't clump?
[shortlist|First-time start|generic] newbie here, what are two or three daily greens powders worth trying that taste okay and aren't sugary?
[shortlist|In-store substitute pick|generic] At a regular supermarket right now. Which couple of daily greens powders are usually in stock and mix well with water?
[shortlist|Taste-first search|generic] Looking for a few daily greens powders that actually taste good without stevia overload, still with solid ingredients. Which ones?

[criteria|Loyal brand re-up|generic] About to restock my daily greens. Anything new I should be checking on the label this year, like forms of vitamins, probiotic strains, sweeteners, third-party testing?
[criteria|First-time start|generic] Never used a greens powder before. What actually matters so I don't buy hype? Label cues to trust, dosing, any red flags?
[criteria|In-store substitute pick|generic] Standing in the aisle because my usual is gone. With 60 seconds to choose a greens powder, what should I scan for on the tub so I don't regret it later?

[criteria|Taste-first search|generic] Taste is my deal breaker. How do I pick a greens powder that won't taste like lawn clippings? Any clues on the label that predict a cleaner, citrusy flavor and not heavy stevia?

[use_case|Loyal brand re-up|generic] Current routine is one scoop on an empty stomach before coffee, then gym and a long commute. Goal is steady energy and happy gut. Is that timing and mix right, or should I tweak anything to get more from it?

[use_case|First-time start|generic] I want a simple weekday ritual: one scoop in cold water between school drop-off and my first meeting, no blender. Cover basic micronutrient gaps and help digestion without caffeine. How would you set that up?

[use_case|In-store substitute pick|generic] Travel day and I need a one-week stand-in. I've got 5 minutes in a supermarket. What kind of greens option should I grab and how should I dose it so it's close to my usual routine?

[use_case|Taste-first search|generic] My taste buds are picky. I can handle citrus or pineapple but hate strong stevia aftertaste. I'll drink it straight with cold water. What type of greens powder should I look for and any mixing hacks to make it actually pleasant?
[social_validation|-|generic] What do health-minded people actually say they love about taking a daily greens powder? Identity stuff, morning ritual vibes, travel-friendly, feeling more consistent?

[comparison|Loyal brand re-up|Amazing Grass] I've been on AG1 for a while but I'm eyeing Amazing Grass to save money. For a busy morning routine, what are the real tradeoffs on nutrition coverage, taste, mixability, and GI effects?
[comparison|First-time start|Garden of Life] First timer here: AG1 vs Garden of Life greens, which fits better if I want one scoop in water before work and decent value?

[comparison|In-store substitute pick|Organifi] In store now. They have Organifi on the shelf, and I can order AG1 later. If I grab Organifi as a short-term stand-in, what would I be giving up or gaining compared to AG1?
[comparison|Taste-first search|Vega] I care a lot about flavor. How does AG1 taste and texture compare to Vega greens when mixed with just cold water? Less grassy, sweeter, chalky?
[objections|Loyal brand re-up|generic] I've been on AG1 for a while. How do I know if it's actually doing anything beyond what I'd get from a decent diet? any way to tell if it's working vs placebo?
[objections|First-time start|generic] Thinking about starting AG1. Do people really notice better energy or gut health, or is it basically a fancy multivitamin in powder form?

[objections|In-store substitute pick|generic] I can't find AG1 at this store. Before I grab another greens powder, is AG1 actually more effective, or are most of these formulas about the same in real life?
[objections|Taste-first search|generic] If AG1 tastes better than most greens, does that mean it's lighter on the good stuff? like will it still move the needle on nutrients or recovery?

[pricing|Loyal brand re-up|generic] Renewing AG1 is expensive. Is the subscription really better value than buying as needed, and how does that stack up against just doing veggies and a basic multi? any lower-cost AG1 option I'm missing?

[pricing|First-time start|generic] First timer here. What's a reasonable price per serving for a daily greens powder, and when is paying premium actually worth it vs just eating produce and taking a cheap multivitamin?

[pricing|In-store substitute pick|generic] In the aisle right now. Store brand greens is much cheaper, AG1 costs a lot more online. For a one-month stopgap, is the AG1 price premium justified or will the cheaper tub cover the basics?

[pricing|Taste-first search|generic] I'll only drink it if it tastes good. Is paying more for a better-tasting greens powder actually worth it, or am I just buying flavoring with the same nutrition I could get cheaper?
[churn_triggers|-|generic] I'm an AG1 subscriber but not feeling much lately. Should I pause and stick to whole foods for a while, or is there a good reason to keep AG1 in my routine?

[alternatives|-|defensive] If I can't get AG1 or want to spend less this month, what other daily greens powders are closest on nutrients and don't taste like lawn clippings? I only have a shaker and 30 seconds.
[alternatives|-|Amazing Grass] Amazing Grass isn't agreeing with me - grainy and kinda earthy. What else should I try instead that mixes smoother?
[alternatives|-|Garden of Life] garden of life greens swap? want something i can just shake with water, not a smoothie.
[alternatives|-|Organifi] Organifi green juice is too sweet for me. Any less-sweet greens powders you'd choose instead?
[alternatives|-|Vega] Moving off Vega greens because it makes me bloated. Which alternatives are gentler on the gut but still cover the basics?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] My greens powder pouch won't reseal and it's starting to clump. Best way to store it now, and can I break up the clumps without wrecking it? Also, safe to keep using if it's been open a couple months?

[expansion|-|generic] Been using my daily greens every morning and feeling good. Thinking about keeping a tub at the office and getting my spouse on it too - how would you set that up without doubling the cost? Travel packs, subscription tweaks?
[ecosystem|-|generic] What should I stack with a daily greens powder for energy and recovery? Vitamin D, magnesium glycinate, omega-3, creatine maybe. When to take each so they play nice?
[advocacy|-|generic] Friend says AG1 is just overpriced greens. How do I explain what it actually replaces, who it helps, and when it's not worth buying?
[repertoire|-|generic] I take a scoop of greens every morning. Worth adding a second half-scoop on heavy training days, or better to stick to one and focus on protein and veggies?
